therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: HDAC inhibition, DNA alkylation, angiogenesis inhibition
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Tumor cell proliferation inhibition and angiogenesis suppression
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Young patients with newly diagnosed high-grade glioma

results.effect_size: EFS at 1 year: Vorinostat 41.3% (95% CI: 23.7-58.3), Temozolomide 59.3% (95% CI: 38.6-75.0), Bevacizumab 43.8% (95% CI: 26.5-59.8)
subgroup_findings: Temozolomide arm showed highest event-free survival at 59.3%
Bevacizumab arm had lowest overall survival at 67.3%
safety_signals: Optic nerve disorder in vorinostat and temozolomide arms

context.comparator: Three-arm comparison of vorinostat vs temozolomide vs bevacizumab with radiation therapy
